title: Configuration bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. If $w(n)$ is the length of the binary expansion of $n+1$, then $(|Q|+1)(n+2)3^{k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^k\le 2^{|Q|+w(n)+3k(2s+1)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
